method: Manually match the original PDF page and extracted material-only image; issue actual historical-bank practice through public API and select it in the installed application; decode and hash its rendered image. No model calls or CSS injection.

tests.coverage: Exact original-stem association, asset hash, duplicate/traversal/junction rejection; real StorageDomain practice projection preserves bank and stored snapshot, options and scoring.

limits: Exactly one manually verified source diagram is associated; other missing diagrams and footer-contaminated options remain unresolved.
Source PDF hash records manually verified provenance; runtime does not authenticate or parse the PDF.
Asset validation happens on plugin startup; changed assets/index require reload.
Private PDFs, images, association index, question identifiers, source text and screenshots are excluded from remote delivery.
Real teaching, streaming, permission, Stop, AI application generation and physical IME remain unverified.
